content.title: MasterCraft (NASDAQ:MCFT) Surprises With Q3 Sales
content.summary: Sport boat manufacturer MasterCraft (NASDAQ:MCFT) reported Q3 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 5.6% year on year to $69 million. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($69 million at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 3.3% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.28 per share was 77.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
